obsah: This week was one of the most demanding I can imagine as a rider and organiser. Thursday started with a morning Trial course for guys who want to fulfil their biker dream and peek behind the scenes of Trial. In the afternoon we headed to Prague 15, where a kids' pump track was being opened with the city leadership in attendance, and my son Márty and I rode a father-and-son exhibition there. On Saturday our team split into 3: Michal Budský and Tobík Dolák rode Forestry Day in Ralsko, Martin Šimůnek and Dominik Budský did an exhibition and workshop in Sokolov, and Lukáš Valný and I went to Javornicko Days, where we rode just before Imagine Diamonds. We finished riding and practically right after us it started raining. Unfortunately, when we got home we found out that a windstorm had swept through the Říčany area and Tehov and flooded our houses/gardens. The parks we manage were hit too, so what followed was dealing with our caretaker duties. On Sunday Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta and Lukáš Valný headed to Solnice for the local Solfest festival, where in incredible heat they rode an exhibition and handed out a few drinks. After returning, more dealing with the aftermath of the windstorm – and that awaits us all next week too.
